nl: Add the line Environment=LOG_LEVEL=warn to the [Service] section of etc/systemd/system/orders.service, directly after the User line.

etc/systemd/system/orders.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orders service
After=network.target

[Service]
User=orders
Environment=LOG_LEVEL=warn
ExecStart=/opt/orders/bin/orders --port 8080
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/systemd/system/orders.service'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('User=orders\n') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('User=orders\n', 'User=orders\nEnvironment=LOG_LEVEL=warn\n'))
EOF
